items.label: Please pair it with your TV before use. Pairing Steps
items.value: 1) Press the power button to turn on your tv. 2) Hold VOL- button and google assistant button for 2 seconds to initiate pairing. 3) All pairing transaction is behind the scene and no setup is required. If you still cannot get the remote paired, please go to the TV Settings dialog for remote pairing and select Pair New Remote. Then hold VOL- button and google assistant key to initiate pairing.
